svg.title: Redrawn from the team's model, Project class diagram 4
svg.desc: A redraw of the class diagram "Project class diagram 4" from the Visual Paradigm model of the Agricultural Supply Chain Platform (team of three, University of Camerino; github.com/daveeCity/IDS_GROUP_PROJECT): 4 packages, 56 classes and 69 relationships in the whole diagram, each at its modelled position, light lines on a night ground. In the accent blue: the associations dettagliare, eseguire and specificare (Prodotto, TracciabilitaProdotto, PassoFiliera, Azienda). Source IDS_project(3).vpp, diagram last modified 2025-12-03. Drawn by scripts/media/vpp-plate.mjs for the portfolio of Alberto Tuveri.
svg.metadata: ORIGIN (drawn from a real artefact, not generated): every shape, name, member and connector read from IDS_project(3).vpp (SQLite, opened read-only), diagram "Project class diagram 4"; uniform scale 0.20205; typography and colours of the site's night studio (Sofia Sans, Sofia Sans Condensed, Sofia Sans Extra Condensed; night, night-2, line, mute, body, ink; one accent thread).
